visual_check: Both single-page official PDFs rendered and inspected. dn161A includes the paragraph inserted by P162, so archive is the amended text, not an unamended September2023 original.
findings: P161 clause1 links Section41 resident status in the year foreign employment/business/property income arises to inclusion in the year the income is brought into Thailand.
P162 inserts exclusion for assessable income arising before1January2024.
P161 clause3 applies to remittances from1January2024 onward.

This is an administrative interpretation under Section41, not a universal tax on every remittance. Treaty relief, exemptions, foreign tax credit, income tracing and historical same-year rules require separate treatment.
